title: Sleepy butterfly
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(-20 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#ffb347' transform='rotate(20 70 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#ff8c42' transform='rotate(15 32 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#ff8c42' transform='rotate(-15 68 62)'/>
  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='37' r='6' fill='#ff5e5b'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='37' r='6' fill='#ff5e5b'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='5' ry='18' fill='#6a4c93'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes (closed) -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q48 44 50 42' stroke='#c9a7f0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 42 Q52 44 54 42' stroke='#c9a7f0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M48 47 Q50 49 52 47' stroke='#c9a7f0' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 34 Q44 26 42 22' stroke='#6a4c93' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 34 Q56 26 58 22' stroke='#6a4c93' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='21' r='2' fill='#c9a7f0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='21' r='2' fill='#c9a7f0'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M64 18 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#8ecae6' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
